description: Deterministic model routing policy (multi-model milestone). Model selection is runtime authority: the canonical catalog (runtime/routing/model-catalog.mjs) and the deterministic routing policy (runtime/routing/routing-policy.mjs) decide provider/model assignments. Workers never self-select, upgrade, or fall back.

selection_rules.action: route to the configured primary model (PRIMARY_ROUTE)

selection_rules.when: task requires a capability (MCP/tools/structured output, quality, context, provider)
selection_rules.action: select the cheapest sufficient capability-compatible model (DIRECT_CAPABILITY_ROUTE / CHEAPEST_SUFFICIENT)

selection_rules.when: a classified failure occurs after worker invocation
selection_rules.action: RETRY_SAME_MODEL (meaningful strategy delta) | ESCALATE (different model, same run_id) | PROVIDER_FALLBACK (allowlisted provider) — bounded by max_model_escalations / max_provider_fallbacks
DENIED/IGNORED — only a policy-validated explicit override may change the route

cost_policy.note: cost_tier/quality_tier/context_tier are stable ordinal policy metadata (LOW < MEDIUM < HIGH); no invented prices

fallback_strategy.notes: Provider fallback only within the explicit allowlist; no silent provider discovery or auto-registration.
